notes.en: Aimed for an engraved Renaissance study built over a generous solid-gold silhouette so the circle, square, and dual-pose limbs stay crisp down to 16px while tiered aged-ink contours separate the overlapping shoulders and thighs and add pectoral, abdominal, facial, and curly-hair detail at large sizes. Still weak: the spread knees and ankle transitions remain slightly schematic compared to the torso, and the fingers rely on fine strokes rather than fully sculpted phalanges.
